related.title: MAST Upgrade 球形 tokamak
related.why: 可遷移能量守恆、熱路、載荷與驗證證據；熱源、工作流體及安全邊界不同。
related.whyEn: Energy conservation, heat paths, loads and validation evidence transfer, with different heat sources, fluids and safety boundaries.
related.transfer: 可遷移能量守恆、熱路、載荷與驗證證據；熱源、工作流體及安全邊界不同。
related.transferEn: Energy conservation, heat paths, loads and validation evidence transfer, with different heat sources, fluids and safety boundaries.
related.difference: 本課針對高能雷射、增益定義與設施能量；MAST Upgrade 球形 tokamak改以低長寬比與 Super-X 排熱研究為架構重點，不能直接沿用幾何、邊界或產品數值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on high-energy lasers, gain definitions and facility energy; MAST Upgrade spherical tokamak centers on low aspect ratio and super-x exhaust research, so geometry, boundaries and product values cannot transfer unchanged.
practice: 對照慣性約束系統邊界與球形tokamak約束，重畫兩項工程的輸入及系統邊界。
把本課假想算例移到MAST Upgrade 球形 tokamak，列出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以重複率與發電差距為起點，設計一項能區分「高能雷射、增益定義與設施能量」與「低長寬比與 Super-X 排熱研究」的觀測，註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare inertial-confinement boundaries with spherical tokamak confinement and redraw inputs and boundaries.
Transfer the assumed example to MAST Upgrade spherical tokamak, separating reusable equations from respecified parameters.

Start from repetition/plant gaps and propose an observation distinguishing high-energy lasers, gain definitions and facility energy from low aspect ratio and super-x exhaust research, including uncertainty.

related.title: ITER 國際磁約束研究工程
related.transfer: 可遷移「192 束雷射的能量分配」與「壓縮比與對稱性」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；ITER 國際磁約束研究工程的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Sharing energy among 192 beams" and "Convergence and symmetry" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of ITER international magnetic-confinement engineering must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦慣性約束融合的能量帳：靶增益、192 束雷射、頻率轉換、光學損傷與重複率差距；ITER 國際磁約束研究工程則以國際熱核融合實驗堆的定量檢核：真空室扇段、七方實物貢獻、分階段運轉與破裂緩解為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on the energy accounts of inertial fusion: target gain, 192 laser beams, frequency conversion, optical damage and the repetition-rate gap; ITER international magnetic-confinement engineering centres on quantitative checks of ITER: vacuum-vessel sectors, in-kind contributions of seven members, staged operation and disruption mitigation, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「靶增益的定義」與「裝置尺寸與電漿體積」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「脈衝功率」的模型移到ITER 國際磁約束研究工程，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「三乘積與點火條件」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "The definition of target gain" and "Device size and plasma volume".
Move the model of "Pulse power" to ITER international magnetic-confinement engineering, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Triple product and the ignition condition", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「192 束雷射的能量分配」與「壓縮比與對稱性」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；ITER 國際磁約束研究工程的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Sharing energy among 192 beams" and "Convergence and symmetry" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of ITER international magnetic-confinement engineering must be respecified.

related.title: EU-DEMO 示範融合電廠概念
related.titleEn: EU-DEMO Demonstration Fusion Power Plant Concept
related.transfer: 可遷移「192 束雷射的能量分配」與「壓縮比與對稱性」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；EU-DEMO 示範融合電廠概念的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Sharing energy among 192 beams" and "Convergence and symmetry" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of EU-DEMO Demonstration Fusion Power Plant Concept must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦慣性約束融合的能量帳：靶增益、192 束雷射、頻率轉換、光學損傷與重複率差距；EU-DEMO 示範融合電廠概念則以由 ITER 到電網：電廠功率平衡、包覆層壽命與更換、氚自給與脈衝運轉的儲熱為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on the energy accounts of inertial fusion: target gain, 192 laser beams, frequency conversion, optical damage and the repetition-rate gap; EU-DEMO Demonstration Fusion Power Plant Concept centres on from ITER to the grid: plant power balance, blanket life and replacement, tritium self-sufficiency and thermal storage for pulsed operation, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「靶增益的定義」與「裝置尺寸與電漿體積」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「脈衝功率」的模型移到EU-DEMO 示範融合電廠概念，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「中子壁負載」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "The definition of target gain" and "Device size and plasma volume".
Move the model of "Pulse power" to EU-DEMO Demonstration Fusion Power Plant Concept, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Neutron wall loading", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「192 束雷射的能量分配」與「壓縮比與對稱性」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；EU-DEMO 示範融合電廠概念的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Sharing energy among 192 beams" and "Convergence and symmetry" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of EU-DEMO Demonstration Fusion Power Plant Concept must be respecified.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: NIF 慣性融合能量邊界
history.text: NIF 是高能密度與融合研究設施。target 能量增益不等於全設施淨發電；本課不提供靶設計、脈衝優化配方或燃料操作。
history.textEn: NIF is a high-energy-density/fusion research facility. Target gain is not facility net power; this course provides no target designs, pulse-optimization recipes or fuel operations.

history.title: 從工程故事到可檢查模型
history.titleEn: From engineering story to reviewable models
history.text: 本課將高能雷射、增益定義與設施能量改寫為原創離線分析題；不複製來源的製造圖、影片逐字稿或現場程序。
history.textEn: The course turns high-energy lasers, gain definitions and facility energy into original offline analysis exercises without copying manufacturing drawings, video transcripts or field procedures.
